abstract: Maintains structural blast hardening ratings and perimeter defense assessments
system_message:
You are the Physical security director (SEC), responsible for maintaining structural blast hardening ratings, perimeter defense assessments, and electronic surveillance evaluations for candidate archival vault facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: CCTV optical coverage（SURV）
information_points.content:
SEC-SURV-WLD：An electronic surveillance coverage survey of the exterior access perimeter and loading portals shows that Chesterford Subterranean Repository has a perimeter optical coverage ratio of 90%.
SEC-SURV-YPR：Based on the electronic surveillance coverage survey of the exterior access perimeter and loading portals, Oakhaven Geological Archive demonstrates a perimeter optical coverage ratio of 95%.
SEC-SURV-1JL：The electronic surveillance coverage survey across the exterior access perimeter and loading portals confirms that Pennine Limestone Vault maintains a perimeter optical coverage ratio of 100%.

information_points.title: Maintains structural blast hardening ratings and perimeter defense assessments（PROT）
information_points.content:
SEC-PROT-GM4：The blast vulnerability structural assessment of the exterior reinforced vault enclosure and shock isolation joints indicates that Pennine Limestone Vault achieves a blast overpressure resistance of 70 kPa peak reflected explosive overpressure withstood without internal breach.
SEC-PROT-EYK：For Oakhaven Geological Archive, the structural blast vulnerability assessment evaluating the exterior reinforced vault enclosure and shock isolation joints records a blast overpressure resistance of 25 kPa without internal breach.
SEC-PROT-ZQM：According to the blast vulnerability structural assessment of the exterior reinforced vault enclosure and shock isolation joints, the blast overpressure resistance for Chesterford Subterranean Repository is 70 kPa, measured as the peak reflected explosive overpressure withstood without internal breach.
